author: Aaronisfrom852

title: Nice interface but otherwise disappointing
body: The app has a beautifully done interface which is nice to interact with, but for my needs it really lacked in functionality. All I wanted was an app that would notify me 10 times a day to drink water and stretch, but within 4 hours of downloading it, the only notifications it sent me were three notifications for some premium feature called Challenges, which I repeatedly dismissed but they kept coming back. This is after being steamrollered into choosing a subscription plan to activate after the free trial without even seeing or using the app at all. Ironically, I had to use a different app to set a reminder to cancel my subscription for this app. You shouldn’t be forcing a subscription the second the app is opened before the technology even has a chance to prove itself, or repeatedly pushing a premium feature so many times in the same day. Disappointing experience.

title: BEWARE
body:
I signed up for the trial and it said that it will auto renew if I don’t cancel after 7 days. 

I didn’t want to subscribe cause I felt that the app was too simplistic and wasn’t worth the money. However I was auto charged without any notification for a ONE YEAR MEMBERSHIP. 

Yes many apps do this but the auto renewal usually just charges the next month or couple of months, yet this app straight up ripped me off $200HKD. 

As an app producer you should be ashamed of yourself for using these gimmicky tactics, it’s not gonna help the app gain a user base in the long run, and of course I will NOT be renewing my membership.
